column2: SM16269 / SM16169SH (chip family id 0x014C; SM16269 sub-variant id 0x014D)
register file as the card ships it in record 0x84 / real-time pack sub-index 1.
STRUCTURE (HIGH, read off the data): 33 registers, each carrying THREE values,
one per colour channel (R, G, B). Record 0x84 is the flat quad stream
(reg, R, G, B) x 33 in the library's order, zero-padded to 256 bytes, with
register 0x02 overwritten at load time with (scan - 1) & 0x3F = 15 for 1/16 scan.
field comments from LEDVISION 9.6 ChipSetting.dll dialogs IDD20174 / IDD20173.
169 = SM16169SH (no sub-id) table, as the seller's config carried it.
Behaviour on the bench: id 0x014C -> per-pixel noise at 2.8-4 A; id 0x0214 -> dark at 0.5 A.

column8: MAX LINE / scan count; PATCHED to scan-1 on load (0x0F for 1/16). The driver chip therefore knows the scan depth itself
[7:6] low-grey high-refresh level; value < 0x40 selects the x64 grey multiplier (else x32)
[7:5] frequency division factor - 1 (269: 2 -> divide by 3; 169-as-shipped: 0 -> divide by 1); [4:3] line grey (0 = 64... see gray_bits: g = 128 << bits); [2] blanking coarse; [1:0] blanking fine
[3:2] low-grey uniformity; [1:0] cross-plate optimisation high bits
[7:4] low-grey compensation 1; [3] open-circuit detect; [2:0] cross level
[5:0] CURRENT GAIN 0-63 (the dialog's per-colour sliders). Note: 0x30 = 48, whereas record 0x01 +0x032..0x035 asks for 43 - the two current paths are independent
[7:4] black-screen standby (0xA = on). A real register, not a terminator

column2: DERIVED GREY DEPTH (vendor GetSupporttedGray, chip 0x14C branch; chips.rs):
Ours: reg07 = 0x44 -> g = 128; reg03 = 0x3F -> m = 64; total = 8192 -> 14 bit. Matches
the Eager module datasheet ("Gray Grade: 14 bits") and basic pack +0x08 = 0x0E.
The 64 x 128 factorisation IS the S-PWM structure: one line's greyscale is emitted
as 64 interleaved sub-periods of 128 counts each rather than one 8192-count burst.
(structure HIGH; the "64 sub-periods" reading of the multiplier is MEDIUM)
SChipControl (record 0x01 +0x0C4..0x0D7, basic pack body +0x91, 20 bytes), identical
in both library files - vendor ResetChipControl + SetGclkNumsOfChipControlByChipCustom:
Byte 1 = 0x0E and bytes 11/13 = 0x97 (151) are unexplained; the accessor name says
this block carries GCLK counts. Meaning of individual bytes: NOT RESOLVED.
